page.overview:
Who is Somsak?

Somsak's father was also a Muay Thai fighter, who once challenged the champion Nuakan. Somsak grew up respecting his father, and after becoming a great fighter he decided to travel the world to test his strength. During his second trip to Japan, he heard that the Rindo-kan dojo had a new instructor and challenged Makoto, being defeated by her.
